component_anchors.text: Nonrecurring-adjusted consolidated earnings provide only a conditional baseline. 因此，Anchor a conditional bridge without asserting segment attribution. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Reconcile baseline to audited segment and cash economics. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金只进入条件范围；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值不适用。晋级检验：Reconcile consolidated baseline to responsibility-unit earnings and cash. 失效检验：Subsequent restatement shows baseline was entirely nonrecurring.

Television/display is the identified core, but segment cash, margin and customer economics are not disclosed separately. 因此，Use only as a conditional operating component; do not infer a durable earnings point estimate. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Disclose responsibility-unit margins, customer terms, receivable ageing and operating cash conversion for television/display across subsequent reports. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金只进入条件范围；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值只作为条件性主要估值输入。晋级检验：Standalone television/display margin and cash conversion disclosure across a cycle. 失效检验：Persistent negative unit cash conversion or margin collapse after working-capital normalization.

Supply-chain revenue was RMB136.52bn in FY2017 and is material, yet trading margins, working-capital funding and cash conversion are not separated. 因此，Keep as optional corroborative input to the conditional route and treat financing pressure as conditional. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Provide matched trading gross profit, receivable/inventory turns and cash-flow attribution by responsible unit. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入条件范围；普通股现金只进入条件范围；对融资压力的影响取决于条件；永久损失进入条件性永久损失路径；估值只作估值交叉验证。晋级检验：Responsible-unit trading margin, turns and cash conversion are reconciled. 失效检验：Receivable/inventory growth continues to consume cash without margin compensation.

White-goods operations are named but no component-level earnings or cash evidence is supplied. 因此，No base earnings, owner-cash or primary valuation credit; monitor only for material downside or later evidence. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Audited segment disclosure of revenue, margin, capital and cash conversion with a defined responsibility boundary. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利排除；普通股现金排除；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失排除；估值排除。晋级检验：Standalone audited economics and cash attribution become available. 失效检验：Evidence shows structurally subscale or cash-consuming operation.

Mobile is listed as a business but its economics and financing needs are not separately observable. 因此，Exclude from base and primary route; any upside remains unbounded. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Subsequent reports provide standalone economics, customer/channel terms and capital absorption. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利排除；普通股现金排除；尚未形成可承保范围；永久损失排除；估值排除。晋级检验：Standalone mobile economics and capital needs are disclosed. 失效检验：Continued absence of evidence or demonstrated negative cash economics.

FY2017 property disposal generated a stated non-sustainable investment gain; named projects had reported投入 but no matched returns or ordinary-shareholder realization path. 因此，Exclude disposal gains and project value from operating base; retain only as an asset-realization stress route. 需要重估这一处理的条件是：Document legally accessible asset value, taxes, ownership claims and a credible distribution or contracted realization path. 该组件的权威经济去向为：正常盈利只进入情景；普通股现金只进入情景；增加融资压力；永久损失只进入压力情景；估值排除。晋级检验：Legally accessible, tax-adjusted realization and distribution evidence. 失效检验：Projects absorb financing without realizable proceeds or returns.

economic_section_anchors.text: 驱动：operating cash conversion（FY2015-FY2017，单位 RMB annual operating cash flow）；低 -4.31426e+09（FY2017 reported operating cash flow），基准 -9.72136e+08（FY2016 reported operating cash flow），高 1.2896e+09（FY2015 reported operating cash flow）。正常盈利传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：No component-level cash bridge.；保守处理：Keep earnings contribution unresolved.。普通股现金传导（权限：只进入条件范围）：影响未知：No component-level cash bridge.；保守处理：Treat owner cash as conditional and financing-dependent.。价值路线权限：只进入条件性价值路线；不在此生成价值、回报或行动数值。翻转证据：A post-cutoff annual report separately reports sustainable television/white-goods margins and operating cash conversion for the responsible units.
